strings.en: Has everyone been brought aboard!? Shaff.
All is well, Your Highness.
Good. Engage the micro-worm drive at once.
What's the Nadesico's status!?
We're OK too. Captain, the Boson Jump, please.
Roger. Erina, how are the Tulip Crystals?
They're fine. Hurry up and get it over with, Captain.
Roger! Akito, Inez, give me a hand!
Please transmit the rendezvous coordinates to the Nadesico.
No problem.
We will now break away from the space pirate Bunker's battleship!
All hands, please brace for impact.
I hope nothing goes wrong...
O sorrowful souls who slumber in my universe...!
Answer these foolish humans... with your wrath...!
Wh-Where are we...!?
Shaff, what is the meaning of this!?
I don't know. ...And our current coordinates are unknown, too.
What the hell is this!? What's going on!?
What about the Nadesico!?
This is the Nadesico! Captain Bright!
Earth... When did it end up like this!?
Coordinates unknown. ...At the very least, this isn't normal space.
...Safe for the moment, then.
Please verify the data on your end too. We'll also...
The analysis results are in, Captain Bright.
That was... awfully fast. I was curious and checked too,
but all I could tell was that space is distorted here.
Space is... warped, ya say?
...We already had the data. I simply cross-checked it.
Data?
Has something like this happened before?
...!! Commander, a spatial distortion... Don't tell me...
...It's the Muge universe.
Wha...!
What!?
You're kidding!?
It's the truth. ...Ever since the Cyber Beast Force base was devastated
by Muge Zorbados's double, I had expected this.
Hmph... That settles what we have to do.
...Yeah. This will probably be... the biggest showdown of this war...
Plus... the Einst series too.
Muge Zorbados...
Fighting him might tell us something...
The Einst series...!? You're saying they're involved too?
No doubt about it... They're here...!
The Muge universe... You're saying the Einst series is here!?
It's not hard to accept.
...Muge Zorbados's universe... and the space the Einst appear from...
They have one thing in common: the ability to manipulate space at will.
Places like the Stone Circle, the way they suddenly appear...
You mean they were coming from another dimension...?
That's creepy. Let's just hurry up and take him down, okay?
But... it still bothers me. In the end... we barely understand any of it...
A role...?
Rom... What's wrong?
It's nothing... Gades spoke of the Cronosians' duty... their role.
If such things really are decided for us in this universe...
then what is the Einst's role...?
Don't overthink it, Big Bro Rom.
If that's how it is, then taking down guys like that is our role,
and getting in our way is the role of the Einst and the like.
I'd like to believe that, Koji.
(...That may not be far off... A duty... a role... Is that it...?)
